sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Hand-painted outlined 2D platformer enemy animation sprite sheet. Reference image is ONLY character identity/style, not pose count/layout. Exactly SIX full-body poses in a precise equal 3-column by 2-row grid on 1536x1024 canvas; 512x512 cells. Chronological reading order. Same camera, scale and identity in every cell, right-facing three-quarter. Subject total height approx 330px, 70px CLEAR transparent padding. Whole cap/body/arms/feet/effects inside each own cell with no overlap. Opaque subject interior, genuine transparent background, no floor, shadow, colored haze, text, labels, borders, scenery or other creatures. Do not copy reference layout. Brambleguard exact bluecore bark/stone/moss model. SIX distinct heavy overhead slam phases. BOTH FISTS act TOGETHER AS ONE TWO-HANDED SLAM so arm continuity unmistakable. 1 ready fists lowered. 2 crouch both fists at chest. 3 BOTH fists raised together overhead, root elbows bent outward. 4 BOTH fists swing forward DOWN toward image right at waist height. 5 deep crouch BOTH fists low at ankle height to image right. 6 return ready fistslow. Keep both fists visible at every phase, exactly2arms, no one-arm reversal. Uniform front-threequarter right camera. Character must be smaller: full height max340px WITH raised arms, widthmax350px. 70px empty transparent margin each cell. No floor, contacteffects, glow, haze or background.
